name: Kitchen Break
description: Small ideas for a few minutes in the kitchen while your agents work.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: Gentle kitchen-break ideas, one at a time, shown on Away Prompts.
help.goal: There is nothing to finish. Take an idea or leave it.
howToPlay: Step away from your desk and read the idea.
Press Another idea if you want a different one.
Press Back at desk when you return.
tips: Ideas are only suggestions. Skip any that do not suit you.
